pages.text: Every journey to another dimension - by Brane Shifter, rift, wormhole, falling through the void or the hyperobject - now takes a moment: the travel animation builds up on screen for under two seconds, and only then do you jump. The loading screen of each world is its own.

Wherever you arrive, you arrive standing: never inside blocks, never in mid-air, never on top of a world's ceiling (the Quantum Foam's Relativity Breakdown, the build limit), never in a fluid or on something that burns. The ground nearby is searched for two free blocks over solid ground - open sky first, otherwise the spot nearest the height you left from.
Only when there is nowhere at all is a small platform built for you, with the room above it cleared. Laws of the place still apply: carry its attunement item.

The $(thing)Planetary Interior$() is the exception to open sky: it has a bedrock roof, so you arrive under it, on dry rock as near y 100 as the cave allows, with a Mantle Breach beside you for the way back.
